Instead, GitHub Actions downloaded and verified the official Gradle 9.8.1 distribution against its fixed digest and sidecar, then invoked its executable explicitly to build the 9.8.2 host binary distribution.

sourceBuildInputs.note: The source tree includes dependency-verification metadata and configures Maven Central and the Gradle Plugin Portal. The CI source-build command completed successfully; this host-only result does not by itself establish a hermetic or independently audited dependency closure for an Android package candidate.
